thread:
ops-bot: ALERT: Canary monitor 'prod-embed-usw2' failing 3x in 5m (severity=warning). Paging oncall for eng-sre :rotating_light:
marc: I'm oncall — looking now. which probe exactly? link?
aisha: that's the embed canary hitting model-serving gateway in us-west-2, id=canary-prod-embed-usw2. seen 500 and timeouts. i'm on it.
ops-bot: Probe detail: https://canary.prod.redwood.example/probes/canary-prod-embed-usw2 — failures=3, last_error="500 Internal Server Error"
marc: ok running quick curl from my laptop to reproduce:
```
curl -v https://canary.prod.redwood.example/health
* TCP_NODELAY set
* Connected to canary.prod.redwood.example (52.23.45.12) port 443
> GET /health HTTP/1.1\n> Host: canary.prod.redwood.example
< HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
< content-type: application/json
{\n  "status":"error",\n  "detail":"upstream timeout"\n}
```
aisha: same here, intermittent. I can see a few 200s then a 500 spike. reproduces from us-west-2 only.
lei: FYI we rolled runtime patch r23.4 to us-west-2 ~01:10 UTC. There were some kernel change optimizations. Could be related to connection pooling.
marc: we'll need to avoid noisy pages. i'll silence the alert for the probe for 30m while we investigate and reduce noise. Executing alertmanager silence now:
```
# alertmanager cli
amtool silence add -l probe=canary-prod-embed-usw2 --duration=30m "investigating intermittent 500s"
```
pagerduty-bot: Silence created (id=abc123), expires in 30m :white_check_mark:
aisha: thanks. i'll ramp up targeted synthetic runs to capture headers and trace id for the 500s. posting a sample header+trace.
```
X-Request-ID: 7d9f3a\nX-Upstream-Latency: 1243ms\nX-Error: upstream_timeout
```
lei: looks like tail latency spikes. The canary timeout is 2s and the probe is 1m frequency — that makes it quite sensitive. Proposal: reduce noise by changing probe config to require 3 consecutive failures before alerting and increase probe interval to 3m. Also adjust alert rule to use rate of failures over 10m.
marc: +1. Also update Grafana dashboard to show 95th p99 latency for canary and overlay recent deploys. that will help correlate.
aisha: draft of suggested canary config change (will push to infra repo as PR):
```yaml
probe:
  id: canary-prod-embed-usw2
  endpoint: https://canary.prod.redwood.example/health
  interval: 3m      # was 1m
  timeout: 5s       # increased from 2s to tolerate tail latencies
  failure_threshold: 3  # require 3 failures in a row
  capture_headers: ["X-Request-ID","X-Upstream-Latency"]
```
lei: and the Prometheus alert rule tweak i propose:
```yaml
- alert: CanaryProbeFailure
  expr: increase(canary_probe_failures_total{probe="prod-embed-usw2"}[10m]) >= 3
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: warning
  annotations:
    runbook: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SRE/pages/12345/canary-runbook
```
marc: that should greatly reduce false positives from short bursts. please put the change behind a feature-flag so we can revert quickly.
aisha: filing follow-up ticket: RDW-2234 "Canary prod-embed-usw2: reduce alert noise and add latency panels" — assigning to eng-runtime and eng-sre for triage. will include traces and the PR links.
sre-runbook-bot: Runbook link added to ticket RDW-2234 and to the alert annotations.
marc: quick mitigation step: add short-term autoscaling bump for the gateway in us-west-2 to reduce upstream timeouts while we triage. ops, can we do +2 instances? @aisha please coordinate.
aisha: submitting infra scale request now, ETA ~4m. will watch if failure rate drops.
ops-bot: Autoscale request accepted; scaling to +2 instances in us-west-2.
lei: once scaling finishes, let's sample traces for 20m and then decide whether runtime patch rollback is needed. if errors persist after scaling, we'll roll back r23.4.
marc: handoff note for next oncall (in ~50m): there's an ongoing investigation RDW-2234, probe silenced for 30m, scaling applied, suggested probe config PR open. no customer-facing incidents reported so far.
aisha: quick customer-impact check: external request latencies to hosted inference in us-west-2 are within SLO (p95 steady) and no active customer complaints. marking as low-impact for now.
marc: thanks everyone. action items: aisha -> open PR for probe + ticket, lei -> verify if runtime patch correlates with latency, eng-runtime -> triage root cause if spikes persist, marc (oncall) -> monitor for 2h then re-evaluate.
ops-bot: NOTE: Silence expires at 1765002911 UTC (30m from now).
